tasks.instructions: Listen to the short announcement and choose the correct answer.

audio.transcript: The sports centre will open at ten o'clock on Saturday instead of eight because the staff are attending a safety training session.

items.question: Why will the sports centre open later on Saturday?
options: The staff have a training session.
items.explanation_vi: Đoạn nghe cho biết nhân viên tham gia buổi tập huấn an toàn.

tasks.instructions: Listen to three people and match each speaker with the activity they prefer.

audio.transcript: Speaker one: I enjoy activities where I can make something useful with my hands. Speaker two: I prefer being outdoors and working with other people to improve the neighbourhood. Speaker three: I like learning practical computer skills that I can use at work.

items.question: Speaker 1
items.explanation_vi: Người nói 1 thích tạo ra đồ vật hữu ích bằng tay.

items.question: Speaker 2
items.explanation_vi: Người nói 2 thích hoạt động ngoài trời để cải thiện khu phố.

items.question: Speaker 3
items.explanation_vi: Người nói 3 muốn học kỹ năng máy tính thực tế cho công việc.

tasks.instructions: Listen to the discussion and identify each speaker's opinion.

audio.transcript: Maya: The new study room is bright and comfortable, but I wish it stayed open later. Daniel: I agree about the room itself, although the booking system is much too complicated. Maya: At least the staff are helpful when there is a problem.

items.question: What concerns Maya most?
items.explanation_vi: Maya mong phòng mở cửa muộn hơn.

items.question: What does Daniel dislike?
items.explanation_vi: Daniel cho rằng hệ thống đặt phòng quá phức tạp.

tasks.instructions: Listen to the longer talk and choose the best answer.

audio.transcript: When I first started working from home, I assumed I would save time and become more productive. In reality, I found it difficult to separate work from the rest of my life. I eventually created a fixed schedule and stopped checking messages after six. The biggest improvement came not from new technology, but from setting clearer boundaries.

items.question: What is the speaker's main point?
options: Working from home requires expensive equipment.
Clear boundaries improved the speaker's routine.
items.explanation_vi: Người nói nhấn mạnh việc đặt ranh giới rõ ràng đã cải thiện thói quen làm việc.
